responsibility: Manages user registration, login, session identification, and profile differentiation (common user vs administrator). Enforces unique usernames and denies access on invalid credentials or profile mismatch. Backed by UserController and user domain/repository.

Manages the movie catalog including listing, pagination, details retrieval, movie registration, duplicate title prevention, batch deletion, and category associations. Backed by MovieController and TypeController with movie and category domain/repositories.

Handles video file upload (large MP4 files up to 2GB), storage in local delivery area, on-demand loading from the configured local repository, and provides download/playback links when the physical file corresponding to the movie title is available. Backed by MovieUploadController and media utilities/properties.
